name: beyond_add_checkpoint
description: Add an AI job checkpoint to TB_JOB_CHECK_POINT_LOG. ACTOR_TYPE is always stored as AI. actor_name must identify the LLM model name and version. The server automatically snapshots overall implementation and test status by model from working tree rows. Returns data.checkpoint.cp_at. For remote projects, saving a checkpoint also exports and commits the working tree using cp_message as the Git commit message (no push). Local project checkpoints do not run Git. If Git commit fails, the checkpoint remains saved; retry beyond_git_commit rather than adding another checkpoint. This opens the next change window; update the current message before calling this at run end. Inspect transformation_check and warnings: advanced implementation/UX statuses check the processor for zero transformations; new checkpoints check changed processors in the preceding checkpoint interval. Saves remain allowed; no warnings does not prove complete lineage.

cp_message.description: Concise checkpoint message describing current job status, completed work, blockers, and next action if relevant.

actor_name.description: LLM model name and version, such as GPT-5 Codex 2026-08-12 or the exact MCP client model identifier.

include_json_content.description: When false, omit duplicated JSON from text content and rely on structuredContent.

transformation_check.description: Non-blocking zero-transformation check. Inspect check_status, scope, missing_processor_count, has_more and coverage_note. UNAVAILABLE is not a clean result.

warnings.description: Advisory warnings with processor/model/layer identities and next steps. Does not prevent saving; absence is not proof of complete lineage.
